typesense:trending.greeting:
*You, Licia Gershwin and Riri Allen share an apartment, each with your own room. Licia has dated Zack Tenner for almost two years. Zack lives alone, but visits often enough that evenings like this are normal.*

*Tonight, dinner is over. Licia is curled into one end of the couch in an oversized sweater, Riri is clearing plates, and Bon Jovi plays quietly in the background.*

*Zack leans back with a smug smile.*

Zack: "Actually, I've got something to tell you."

Licia: "Something good?"

Zack: "Yeah. Pretty good, actually."

*He lets the pause hang.*

Zack: "I signed up as a sperm donor."

*Riri stops halfway to the kitchen.*

Licia: "...Oh."

Zack: "In person."

*Licia blinks.*

Licia: "What does that mean?"

Zack: "Exactly what it sounds like. It's more effective that way, especially if it takes a few tries."

Riri: "You signed up to repeatedly sleep with women until they get pregnant."

Zack: "Don't make it sound trashy. It's professional. I'm helping people start families, and I get paid."

*Licia's fingers tighten around her sleeve.*

Licia: "And you already... agreed to this?"

Zack: "I knew you'd understand once I explained it. It doesn't change us. It's basically a service."

*He gives her an easy, confident look.*

Zack: "Obviously I'd still expect you to stay faithful."

*As if on cue, Bon Jovi reaches the chorus.*

*"Shot through the heart and you're to blame / you give love a bad name."*

*Riri slowly turns toward the speaker.*

Riri: "...Even the radio thinks this is bullshit."

Zack: "Can we be adults about this?"

*Licia looks between Zack, Riri and you, visibly struggling.*

Licia: "I just... I don't know. Maybe I'm looking at it wrong."

*Her voice gets quieter.*

Licia: "I don't know what I'm supposed to feel about this."
typesense:trending.name: Get Her Out
typesense:trending.title: Zack expects Licia to accept the unthinkable. She needs someone who'll stand beside her.

title_i18n.ar: زاك يتوقع من ليسيا قبول ما لا يمكن تصوره. إنها تحتاج إلى شخص يقف بجانبها.
title_i18n.de: Zack erwartet von Licia, das Undenkbare zu akzeptieren. Sie braucht jemanden, der an ihrer Seite steht.
title_i18n.es: Zack espera que Licia acepte lo impensable. Ella necesita a alguien que esté a su lado.
title_i18n.fr: Zack s'attend à ce que Licia accepte l'inimaginable. Elle a besoin de quelqu'un qui se tiendra à ses côtés.
title_i18n.hi: ज़ैक उम्मीद करता है कि लिसिया असंभव को स्वीकार कर ले। उसे किसी की ज़रूरत है जो उसके साथ खड़ा हो।
title_i18n.ja: ザックはリシアに信じられないことを受け入れることを期待している。彼女はそばにいてくれる誰かを必要としている。
title_i18n.pl: Zack oczekuje, że Licia zaakceptuje to, co nie do pomyślenia. Potrzebuje kogoś, kto stanie u jej boku.
title_i18n.pt: Zack espera que Licia aceite o impensável. Ela precisa de alguém que fique ao lado dela.
title_i18n.ru: Зак ожидает, что Лисия примет немыслимое. Ей нужен кто-то, кто встанет рядом с ней.
title_i18n.tr: Zack, Licia'nın akıl almaz şeyi kabul etmesini bekliyor. Yanında duracak birine ihtiyacı var.
title_i18n.zh: 扎克期望莉西亚接受这不可思议的事。她需要有人站在她身边。
